title: Seagrove "How Sweet It Is" 15 Lake Vista Lane
h1: Seagrove "How Sweet It Is" 15 Lake Vista Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 4th Floor lookout tower with Gulf views- Deeded beach access directly across the street- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $45 per day**- Walkable distance to The Greenway Station - Shopping & Dining - 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- 2 Dishwashers- Sonos- Stand Alone Ice Maker- Washer/Dryer on multiple floors- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: How Sweet It Is to stay in this beautiful Seagrove Beach home, a luxury beach cottage boasting 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 10 guests in total coastal bliss. With breathtaking Gulf views, a private pool, and dedicated beach access across the street, this stunning home offers a quieter stretch of shoreline perfect for any vacation. Spend crowdless mornings soaking in the natural beauty of the Gulf, afternoons strolling the shops of 30A, and nights sipping cocktails from this home’s lookout tower!On the first floor of this elegant home is a guest bedroom with a king bed, 50” Smart TV, and private bathroom with a shower. A hallway door opens to a screened porch with an alfresco dining table and a covered patio with a 65” Smart TV and cushioned wicker chairs. Lounge in the sun or cool off in the pool for a fun and relaxing getaway.Pale wood floors, white shiplap walls, and elegant furnishings on the second floor’s open living, dining, and kitchen areas create a soothing environment for guests. French doors from the living area open to a covered porch with views of the neighborhood and the Gulf. In the living area, a sectional sofa and 2 armchairs face a 75” Smart TV for entertainment. The dining table seats 7 with beautiful views of Seagrove Beach, while the chef’s kitchen boasts a waterfall marble island with seating for 3 more. A farmhouse sink, 2 dishwashers, a gas cooktop, and high-end appliances make meal prep easy. When it’s time to retire, the second-floor guest bedroom offers versatility with 1 queen bed, 1 built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed, and its own private bathroom—perfect for families.The third-floor guest bedroom features a king bed, 50” Smart TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. Meanwhile, the primary bedroom offers an array of luxurious amenities, including a king bed, private balcony with serene Seagrove views, a cozy sitting area, walk-in closet, and 65” Smart TV. Also, an elegant private bathroom with marble floors, a soaking tub with Gulf views, dual-head glass shower, and double vanity with a make-up bench.The partially-covered lookout tower boasts incredible Emerald Coast views from the fourth floor, perfect for sunset toasts around the high-top table. Unwind under the covered outdoor living area with a soft sofa and 65” Smart TV.How Sweet It Is boasts a private pool, serene Gulf views, and designated beach access for a private getaway in paradise! Explore nearby gems with the 6-passenger low-speed vehicle or 4 complimentary bikes.
